summary: A CIP identity item where the order code is buried at the front of the product name, which is the only place Rockwell equipment ever puts it.

device.description: Conpot running its default template, presenting itself as a ControlLogix 1756-L61
device.derivation: Conpot delegates its EtherNet/IP encapsulation to cpppo, so unlike the Modbus and S7 fixtures this frame is built from the encoding the EtherNet/IP specification defines rather than from the emulator's own code, carrying the field values of enip.xml: VendorId 1, DeviceType 14, ProductCode 90, SerialNumber 7079450 and the product name 1756-L61/B LOGIX5561. The template gives ProductRevision as the single number 2562, which fills the two octet revision field as major 2 and minor 10. The sender context is the one this build sends and the device echoes.
